selection_basis: Existing human-reviewed, deliberately vulnerable production sinks in pinned public benchmark anchors; selected before this expansion's scanner execution.
selection_prohibitions: Do not use independent evaluation pairs or protected holdouts.
Do not infer labels from scanner output.
Do not replace an anchor because a scanner misses its target.
Do not treat unmatched scanner candidates as false positives.
review_policy: A detector hit becomes an unassessed review candidate. Human adjudication must independently confirm reachability, attacker control, mitigation, and operational actionability before any classifier label is recorded.
